neighbours.label: the final digit of the year in a full date in 1805 or 1825 ('September of 1805', 'February 15, 1805', 'June 1825'); other years in the same frame (1845, 1855, 1905) are weak. The pole also fires on unrelated pieces (' Harper', 'if' of 'classif', a '5' in an ISBN), so this is one facet
fire: The captain's journal records that in November of 1805 the party reached the coast.
In a note of April 22, 1805, to her sister, she complains of the cold.
On the 3rd of August 1825, the fleet left the harbour.
The parish book shows that in January of 1805 the bridge was washed away.
In a letter of May 9, 1825, to the bishop, he asks for more time.
On the 20th of March 1805, the two armies met near the river.
The ledger shows that in July of 1825 the mill changed hands.
In a report of October 1, 1805, to the council, the surveyor lists the damage.
